scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: This is the sole candidate passing all frozen hard gates. The significant immune transition is spatially coherent, with complete contained nuclei and preserved protected structures under the predeclared maximum-safe fallback.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 78,073-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 73,895-pixel tissue component remains above the 70,779-pixel hard floor and is the certified batch maximum-safe result.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 127 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.900, 1.197, 0.959 and 1.003.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.892.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is more numerous and has smaller nuclei than source, although spatial clustering remains close to source. The maximum-safe joint area is below the nominal desired interval but above the significant hard floor under the frozen fallback. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality; another target for this patient abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the population and maximum-safe fallback limitations.
